name: @skitterbyte/skitterspec-github
description: Spec-driven development for Claude Code, with one-way GitHub sync — a superset of @skitterbyte/skitterspec: the base filesystem workflow plus /spec-status · /spec-push · /spec-claim and the spec-sync CLI, mirroring specs to GitHub Issues, sub-issues and a Projects v2 board, with GitHub Releases. The repo is canonical; GitHub is a generated mirror. Install this OR the base OR one other superset — exactly one.
author: Reuben Greaves
